component.name: Pineapple Steam Recording Exporter
菠萝Steam录制导出工具
component.summary: Export Steam game recordings to MP4 videos
将Steam游戏录制内容导出为MP4视频

description.p: Pineapple Steam Recording Exporter is a Qt6-based application that helps you automatically identify and export Steam game recordings to MP4 video files. It provides a user-friendly interface to browse, preview, and convert your Steam game clips without quality loss.
菠萝Steam录制导出工具是一个基于Qt6的应用程序，可以帮助您自动识别和导出Steam游戏录制为MP4视频文件。 它提供了一个用户友好的界面来浏览、预览和无损转换您的Steam游戏片段。
Key features:
主要功能：

ul.li: Automatic detection of Steam game recordings
Lossless export to MP4 format using FFmpeg
内置视频预览和播放功能
Game name resolution from Steam metadata
从Steam元数据解析游戏名称
Built-in HTTP Server for sharing exported video with local network devices
内置 HTTP 服务器以供用于分享导出的视频到局域网设备
